newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Dutch Queen Beatrix visits S.African township.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Queen Beatrix visits S.African township.

text.p: Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands went for a walkabout on Wednesday in a deprived black South African township and was shown what locals hope is a sign of a brighter future for apartheid's victims.
The queen of one of South Africa's former colonial powers toured a housing project hoping to bring new low-cost homes to hundreds of residents of Vosloorus, a rough satellite town near Johannesburg.

She was on the third day of a four-day state visit, the first by a Dutch head of state, which puts the royal seal of approval on the two countries' reconciliation after four decades of apartheid. She heads to Cape Town on Thursday.
